response.overview: The Tasmanian Devil wakes up in his bedroom and finds three cleaning utensils (a soap bar, a toothbrush and a cotton swab) who come in and try to get Taz to clean himself and his place up because his girlfriend Tasmanian She-Devil is going to come over and they're trying to get him to impress her. However, in the end when she comes over though, she is angry and messes up the place again because she prefers Taz and his place the way they were.
response.title: Oh Taz You Devil
